messages:
maria_support: FYI corp-ignite reports ~240k credits vanished overnight, billing spike at ~02:00 UTC :grimacing:
ana_support: Ack. Account corp-ignite (acct-id: corp-ignite-42)?
kevin_billing: Confirmed acct corp-ignite-42 — saw ~238,720 tokens consumed across embeddings + rerank endpoints between 01:50-02:05 UTC.
sam_eng: Any sign of a customer-side loop or retries? Could be transient 502s causing client retries.
maria_support: Customer says they didn't change anything. They run nightly vectorize job on new docs.
ops-bot: Deploy notice: rerank-service v2.11 rolled at 01:47 UTC to region-us-west-2 (canary->prod).
luis_infra: Hmm — logs show a flurry of 429/503 from our edge at 01:48, followed by a burst of 200s but duplicate request-ids. Looks like worker retry fan-out.
sam_eng: Paste of log snippet:
```
2026-02-17T01:48:05Z rerank-worker-7 "POST /v1/rerank" req_id=abc123 attempt=1 status=503
2026-02-17T01:48:06Z rerank-worker-7 "POST /v1/rerank" req_id=abc123 attempt=2 status=200 cost_tokens=842
2026-02-17T01:48:07Z rerank-worker-8 "POST /v1/rerank" req_id=abc123 attempt=1 status=200 cost_tokens=836
```
sam_eng: Looks like two workers retried the same job after the initial 503 and both were accepted downstream — double charge.
nana_support: Can we identify duplicate request_id mapping? This is likely our idempotency key not being respected across retries/goroutines.
luis_infra: We had a partial rollout that changed our retry middleware timing; it accidentally removed dedup based on idempotency header for internal job clients in v2.11 canary. That matches the deploy timestamp.
kevin_billing: Customer impacted: nightly job runs 3k docs -> each doc triggers embedding + rerank -> doubles -> explains ~240k tokens.
maria_support: Customer asks for credits refunded and free-trial extension. They flagged to acct manager.
sam_eng: Proposed mitigation: rollback v2.11 in us-west-2 for rerank-service (already started), and push a hotfix to re-enable dedup on the client path.
luis_infra: Rollback complete at 01:56 UTC. Monitoring shows new requests de-duped.
kevin_billing: For immediate customer remediation: recommend refunding the excess credits (we can compute baseline from yesterday's run) and apply a one-week free-trial extension. Approving provisional credit hold until we reconcile. @kevin_billing :thumbsup:
nana_support: I'll draft the customer response and ask for logs/ints. Can we also provide steps for them to re-run their ingest with a flag to skip already-processed docs?
sam_eng: Repro steps for internal ticket: 1) Deploy v2.11 canary 2) run nightly ingestion with parallel workers (n>=6) 3) introduce transient 503 from edge 4) observe duplicate charges. I'll attach a minimal replay script to the issue.
maria_support: Created support ticket SUP-9821 and linked to infra incident INC-2207.
kevin_billing: I'll create a provisional credit for 240k tokens and mark as pending reconciliation. We'll adjust if reconciliation shows actual overcharge less than that.
nana_support: Customer reply draft: "Thanks — we identified a platform retry bug during a recent rollout that caused some duplicate requests. We've rolled back and are provisioning provisional credits. Please hold off re-ingesting until we confirm the hotfix." Will send once Kevin confirms credit.
sam_eng: Adding note: add end-to-end idempotency tests to our CI for rerank/embedding flows. Low-risk but critical.
maria_support: Thanks team. I'll follow up with the customer and close once credits applied. :white_check_mark:
